reason: The unit economics are completely off—charging ₹99 for 100g when I can get a half-kilo bottle of Maggi for ₹72 makes it feel like an overpriced gimmick.
objection: ₹99 for 100g feels steep when a 200g pouch of Mother's Recipe is ₹70 and 500g Maggi is ₹72.
would_change_my_mind: Pricing it closer to ₹50 for 100g or selling a 300g family pack for ₹140.
